consequence_anchor_contract.freeze_order: Anchor contracts must be frozen before any A3/A4 qualification scoring that consumes them.

control_contract.initial_supported_scope: Structured straight-line flow plus conditional branches and returns sufficient for the frozen six-seed qualification universe; any unsupported material construct on an anchored path fails closed rather than being approximated.
control_contract.ordering_source: language parser or validated structured syntax tree

core_decision.reason: The frozen vocabulary already contains every semantic node/edge family required by A3/A4; the observed insufficiency is loss of definition identity plus absent execution/effect materialization, not a missing ontology.

design_goal: Satisfy the nine frozen downstream observability obligations with the smallest semantic delta while preserving A2 v0.1 byte-for-byte as historical evidence.

forbidden_shortcuts: symbol-name equality as proof of value identity
shared coordinate node across distinct definition sites
source-line ordering as a substitute for reaching-definition semantics
minimal_deltas.purpose: Replace may-flow symbol coalescing only in the overlay with definition-sensitive value instances and exact carrier/binding lineage.
required_semantics: Each function parameter, assignment/definition, field/serialization write, call result, and required expression temporary receives a distinct content-addressed value-instance identity.
A later write kills the prior reaching definition on the same straight-line path; branch joins preserve the explicit set of reaching definitions rather than collapsing them into one symbol node.
Reads consume their reaching definition set; ambiguous or unsupported reaching-definition state remains explicit and cannot be promoted to a must claim.
Representation fields are bound to a particular representation-instance identity, not only a lexical field name, so two objects carrying the same field name do not alias by construction.
Unique acquired call binding is extended with actual-to-formal and return-to-call-result lineage; ambiguous call resolution remains incomplete.
Argument index, keyword/field key, receiver/resource role, and representation slot remain explicit binding identities.

minimal_deltas.minimality_boundary: No whole-program CFG, pointer analysis, arbitrary loop invariant engine, or exception semantics is required for v0.1 of the overlay. Unsupported structure fails closed.
minimal_deltas.purpose: Expose only the execution structure necessary for guard control, must-path, and ordering proofs.
required_semantics: Materialize a parser-derived intraprocedural control skeleton with explicit function entry, guard branch polarity, consequential anchors, returns/exits, and joins required to preserve path alternatives.
Use PRECEDES for semantic control-flow succession derived from language parser/structured syntax, never raw line-number order alone.

Use GUARDS from a guard to the immediately controlled branch/region or anchored node with explicit true/false polarity; transitive guard-to-effect dominance is derived later, not guessed during extraction.
Mark each analyzed function/control region with control_completeness=COMPLETE or INCOMPLETE_FOR_MUST_PATH.

Unsupported control constructs, ambiguous nesting, unresolved exceptional/async transfer that can affect the anchored path, or incomplete JavaScript/TypeScript structure force INCOMPLETE_FOR_MUST_PATH.
Interprocedural A4 proof is permitted only through uniquely bound acquired callees with complete summaries; otherwise abstain.

forbidden_shortcuts: callee/function name alone as effect semantics
treating every call or return as a consequential effect
minimal_deltas.purpose: Make effect/resource/outcome meaning explicit without inferring consequence semantics from names, comments, or arbitrary calls.
required_semantics: A separate content-addressed consequence-anchor contract declares the effect cut and any consequence-relevant resource/binding slots for the analysis scope.
The contract may also declare success/no-effect/rejection/failure outcome anchors when those distinctions are required by the consequence contract.
Each anchor must resolve uniquely to provenance-bearing acquired syntax/operation evidence for the analyzed revision; zero or multiple resolutions force assurance incomplete.
The overlay materializes resolved anchors as EFFECT plus optional RESOURCE, OUTCOME, and FAILURE nodes using the already-frozen CTV vocabulary.
The anchor contract is scope authority only: it states what consequence boundary is being checked, not whether the target preserves it and not any mutation truth.
Qualification anchor contracts must be frozen before downstream A3/A4 scoring and must not contain expected_truth, expected_e2_primary, operator id/class, or mutation-specific repair knowledge.

minimality_argument.D1_is_necessary: Without definition-sensitive instances, the frozen 37-cell coalescing witness survives and overwrite/kill semantics remain unprovable.
minimality_argument.D2_is_necessary: Without an explicit complete control skeleton, guard existence cannot distinguish guarded effect, ignored guard, bypass, fallback, or effect-before-guard.
minimality_argument.D3_is_necessary: Without declared consequence anchors, effect/outcome meaning must be guessed from names/comments/arbitrary calls, which the frozen gate forbids.
minimality_argument.no_fourth_delta_needed: Representation survival, binding identity, resource identity, and outcome distinction can be expressed by D1-D3 using the already-frozen CTV node/edge vocabulary; adding new ontology is therefore not yet justified.

A3_BINDING_IDENTITY.proof_surface: Exact argument/field/receiver/resource slot identity bound to the declared consequence surface.

A3_DATAFLOW.proof_surface: Versioned DERIVES/CARRIES/BINDS_TO paths from reaching definitions; no name-only flow.

A3_DEFINITION_SENSITIVITY.proof_surface: Distinct content-addressed definitions plus kill/merge reaching-definition semantics.

A3_REPRESENTATION_SURVIVAL.proof_surface: Source value instance -> representation-instance field value -> effect binding path.

A4_CONTROL_DEPENDENCE.proof_surface: Branch-polarized GUARDS/PRECEDES graph reaching the declared EFFECT.

A4_MUST_PATH.proof_surface: All-path/dominance reasoning only when control_completeness is COMPLETE.

A4_ORDERING.proof_surface: Parser-derived PRECEDES relation; source coordinates remain evidence only.

A4_OUTCOME_DISTINCTION.proof_surface: Distinct anchored OUTCOME/FAILURE nodes on explicit control paths.

overlay_contract.base_ir_immutability: The overlay may reference base node/edge ids but may not mutate, replace, delete, or reinterpret any frozen A2 v0.1 node or edge.
overlay_contract.content_addressing: All overlay nodes/edges and anchors must be content-addressed from semantics plus exact provenance; iteration order must not affect bytes.
overlay_contract.determinism: Canonical JSON and two-replay byte identity remain mandatory.
overlay_contract.provenance: Every materialized overlay semantic node must resolve to exact acquired source evidence or an explicit contract anchor that itself resolves to such evidence.

gates: A2 v0.1 output remains byte-identical to its frozen implementation on the 58-cell universe.
Overlay builds deterministically or fails closed on all 58 cells.
No multi-definition coalescing remains in definitive A3 candidate paths; multiplicity at joins is explicit.
Every definitive A4 candidate has a uniquely resolved effect anchor and COMPLETE control skeleton.
Guarded, bypass, fallback, ignored-guard, and effect-before-guard structures are distinguishable without truth/operator/comment/name features.
Preserving refactors remain stable under the overlay semantics.
Two replay attempts produce byte-identical overlay receipts.
Independent specialization scan remains zero for target/repository literals used as detector semantics.

value_identity_contract.kill_rule: A definite write on a path replaces the reaching-definition set for that coordinate/slot on that successor state.
value_identity_contract.merge_rule: At a control join, the reaching-definition state for a coordinate/slot is the explicit union of predecessor states. No synthetic single value identity may erase multiplicity.
value_identity_contract.must_lineage_rule: A must-lineage claim is permitted only when every reaching alternative admitted by the complete control skeleton satisfies the same required source/slot lineage.
value_identity_contract.temporary_rule: Unnamed call/expression results that cross a carrier boundary receive content-addressed temporary value identities rather than being dropped.
